name: Thomas Hübl
reason: Health rule (judgement call, flagged for the owner): his own site (thomashuebl.com) frames most of his current work as trauma healing: all three books shown (Healing Collective Trauma, Attuned: Practicing Interdependence to Heal Our Trauma, Releasing Our Burdens with IFS founder Richard Schwartz), the Ancestral Healing Code course, a five-month training for healing practitioners on individual, ancestral and collective trauma, Foundations of Trauma-Informed Coaching, and the Pocket Project on collective trauma.
